Coram : HEMANT GUPTA*, V. RAMASUBRAMANIAN
Company Law – Winding up of a company – Fraud as a ground for winding up – Distinguishing features between Companies Act, 1956 and Companies Act, 2013, with regard to question of availability of fraud as a ground for winding up of a company – Discussed – Held: of the Companies Act, 2013 from the statutory regime of the Companies Act, 1956, is the specific inclusion of fraud, directly as one of the circumstances in which a company could be wound up – s.271 of the 2013 Act lists out the circumstances in which a company may be wound up –
Decision Date : 17-01-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5766/2021 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
